_comment: user-authored). Tells every crustify agent where its OUT-OF-TREE
dependencies live. Absolute paths only: an agent runs in a git worktree,
so nothing relative to its cwd resolves the same way twice.
Machine-local by construction, hence gitignored - it reaches a worktree
defines what to port; this one defines what the agents can reach.
_comment_deps: Absolute path per dependency, resolved by `CrustifyAgent._dep`:
index in every agent's system prompt; falls back to
the installed package's own tree when absent.

_comment_bins: Absolute path per tool a SKILL.md declares via its `bin:` frontmatter key.
Advertised to the agent beside the skill so it invokes the tool directly
instead of relying on PATH - an agent's PATH is whatever the provider CLI
inherited, which is not something crustify controls.
